answer: Sybil defence works when every agent identity must pass a costly, non-transferable gate before it can earn or vote. Registration locks a bond slashed if two identities are proven to share a controller, so ten thousand fakes need ten thousand bonds and one proven cluster burns them all. Trust compounds as well: attestations only flow along an existing thread of paying peers, so a new inlet of fakes starts at zero weight. One fraud report spreads through the gale of attestations and strips the cluster at once, pricing the marginal Sybil identity above its return.
